basic_details.organization_name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) has released the official Tourism Monitors Notification 2026 on the official website, https://www.irctc.com. A total of 5 vacancies have been announced under the IRCTC Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026. Candidates not exceeding 35 years of age and possessing a Bachelor's Degree in Tourism or a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with a Diploma/Post Graduate Degree in Travel & Tourism are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 06-08-2026. The official notification PDF and walk-in details are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum age limit is 35 years. Upper age is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST applicants, by 3 years for OBC applicants and by 10 years for PwBD applicants. Ex-Service Men - Up to the extent of service rendered in defence plus 3 yrs.

qualification.education_qualification: 3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism, 3-years Bachelor Degree in any stream + 2-years Post Graduation Degree/ Diploma in Travel & Tourism
qualification.details: 3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism; or 3-Years bachelor degree in any stream + 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism or 3-years Bachelor Degree in any stream + 2-years Post Graduation Degree/Diploma in Travel & Tourism

IRCTC Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IRCTC Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for IRCTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Tourism Monitors.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Tourism Monitors?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Tourism Monitors post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Tourism Monitors posts is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for IRCTC Tourism Monitors?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for IRCTC Tourism Monitors is scheduled for 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Tourism Monitors?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Tourism Monitors is 35 years, with applicable age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Tourism Monitors at IRCTC?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Tourism Monitors will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 30000 to Rs. 35000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism, or a 3-Years bachelor degree in any stream with a diploma or post-graduation in Travel & Tourism.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IRCTC?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) is www.irctc.com.
